description: A property of propositional formulas holds for every formula if it holds for each atom and falsum and is preserved by negation and the three binary constructors.
signature:

  (falsum : motive Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.Propositional.PropFormula.falsum)
  (neg : (a : Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.Propositional.PropFormula α) → motive a → motive a.neg)
  (conj :
    (a a_1 : Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.Propositional.PropFormula α) → motive a → motive a_1 → motive (a.conj a_1))
  (disj :
    (a a_1 : Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.Propositional.PropFormula α) → motive a → motive a_1 → motive (a.disj a_1))
  (impl :
    (a a_1 : Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.Propositional.PropFormula α) → motive a → motive a_1 → motive (a.impl a_1))
  (t : Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.Propositional.PropFormula α) : motive t
